evidence: verify_christensen_2018_wsssf_2171.R. (A) Each of the 60 short-form columns in WSS-SF_2171.csv matches exactly one full-length Chapman column in share_2171n_WSS-SF.csv across all 2,171 rows (1 hit each, never 0 or 2), recovering its original item number; the resulting four number sets are identical to the four lists Winterstein et al. (2011) print - mi 1,2,5,6,9,12,13,21,22,23,24,25,26,27,29; pb 8,10,11,13,16,19,21,23,24,25,26,27,29,30,31; sa 1,3,4,7,10,13,14,17,19,21,26,30,31,35,37; py 3,10,15,19,24,29,35,36,39,42,45,46,47,54,60 - 60/60. (B) The keyed direction read from each shipped Appendix A item's wording agrees with the .sav value label on its matched full-length column and with the shipped option_text at resp=1, 60/60 (e.g. mi11 'Numbers like 13 and 7 have no special powers.' is the Magical Ideation short form's only False-keyed item and mi01..mi15's only False-keyed .sav column is mi24, its 11th; Social Anhedonia's six False-keyed positions 4,9,11,12,13,14 are exactly the six positively-worded appendix items; Physical Anhedonia's four True-keyed positions 5,6,8,10 are exactly its four negatively-worded items). PARTIAL, not VERIFIED: the keying signature is not injective. Perceptual Aberration is True-keyed on all 15 items so contributes zero discrimination, Magical Ideation pins only 1 of 15, Social Anhedonia splits 9/6 and Physical Anhedonia 4/11. Two same-scale, same-keying items (e.g. mi01 vs mi02, or pb01 vs pb02) are NOT separated from each other by any route run here; their order rests on Appendix A being printed in ascending original-item-number order, which (A) shows the data columns follow but does not prove of the appendix. No per-item statistics are published for this instrument, so no route 1 check exists.

route: explicit code labels in the study's own supplement (SI 1) + route 3 published subscale totals + route 8 content clusters (permutation) + option-axis keying check
evidence: Primary route: code-label match. The study's own supplement (SI 1, osf.io/c6rqy, CC0) prints all 60 items each prefixed with the live item code -- 'PY1: I have often found walks to be relaxing and enjoyable (reversed).' against py01, ... 'MI15: I have worried that people on other planets may be influencing what happens on Earth.' against mi15 -- 60/60, zero mismatches after lowercasing and zero-padding, which is exactly what data/christensen_2018_wsssf.py does to the source header (src.columns = [c.lower() for c in src.columns]; `item` IS the source column name). That tie distinguishes every item from every other. Corroborated against the data in verify_christensen_2018_wsssf_5831.R, three ways. (A) Route 3, published subscale totals, paper Table 1, n=5,831 column, published vs observed: Physical Anhedonia 2.09 (2.30) 0-14 vs 2.09 (2.30) 0-14; Social Anhedonia 1.77 (2.41) 0-15 vs 1.77 (2.41) 0-15; Perceptual Aberration 1.21 (2.28) 0-15 vs 1.21 (2.28) 0-15; Magical Ideation 3.26 (2.91) 0-15 vs 3.26 (2.91) 0-15. A py/pb swap would read 2.09 against 1.21. (B) Route 8, a priori content clusters against a within-subscale permutation null (20,000 draws): the three 'walk' items py01/py02/py04 average r=0.422 against a py mean of 0.161 and are the top 3 of all 105 py pairs (p=0.0025, floor 1/455); pb03/pb07 (decaying inside / rotting away) r=0.596 and pb02/pb15 (is my body really my own) r=0.503 are the top two of 105 pb pairs, mean 0.549 vs subscale 0.277 (p=0.00015); sa06/sa11/sa12 average 0.398 vs 0.205 (p=0.0024); mi07/mi13/mi14 and mi12/mi15 average 0.245 vs 0.173 (p=0.0003). (C) Option axis: the paper states the cells are endorsement-coded and 'after reverse-scoring as needed, all items were scored so that higher scores reflected higher levels of schizotypy'; the 18 items SI 1 marks reversed have endorsement rates of at most 0.276 (py04), not the ~0.9 a raw true/false coding would give, so resp=1 is 'False' for those and 'True' for the other 42 -- 0 of 120 shipped option_text rows disagree with that keying. What A-C do NOT establish on their own is the order of items inside a content cluster (py01 vs py02 vs py04); that separation rests entirely on the code-label match above, which is why the status is VERIFIED.
